systemChanges: Each ARAM: Mayhem game now features a random Headliner band that changes the rules: K/DA (collect 4 cards for an extra Augment), HEARTSTEEL (Augments can roll stronger modifiers), True Damage (takedowns and tower kills can drop Anvils for your team), Pentakill (boost one ability at game start and at level 18), Disco (dance under the disco ball to give everyone Gold), Cafe Cuties (Health relics are stronger), Bees (collect honey pots and dodge bees crossing the map), and Command Line (reroll one Augment into a higher tier in every selection).

New progression: band missions from K/DA, Pentakill, and others reward Augments, emotes, Orange Essence, and more. Games and missions raise your Superstar Rank from Newbie to Superstar, unlocking new bands and missions.
Butcher's Bridge and Koeshin's Crossing are unavailable in Mayhem this patch and are expected to return next patch.

Augment pool changes during 26.16–26.20: Upgrade Sundered Sky and Upgrade Ravenous Hydra (26.16) and Ultra Hydra and Upgrade Death's Dance (26.17) were added; Clown College returned in 26.18; Chain Reaction became Gold and Double Tap became Prismatic.

mayhem.summaryEn: Patch 26.21, Journey to Stardom, is a major ARAM: Mayhem update: 35 new Augments (10 Silver / 19 Gold / 6 Prismatic), 13 removals, random Headliner rules each game, and a new progression system. Crit marksman staples such as Fan the Hammer and Critical Missile were removed, so routes built around them need review.

augmentChanges.name: Blue Barrier
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): Gain a Shield when you cast an ability, scaled by its mana cost.

augmentChanges.name: Flow of Spirit
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): Using a specific ability grants stacking Attack Speed.

augmentChanges.name: Fruitify
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): Enemy champion takedowns create Fruit that you and allies can pick up for healing.

augmentChanges.name: Gift of the Drowned
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): All Bonus Health from your items converts to Lethality.

augmentChanges.name: Hands off the Talent
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): Attacks deal extra damage when fired from max range.

augmentChanges.name: Lich Brain
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): Gain Ability Power based on your Bonus Health.

augmentChanges.name: Lonely Warrior
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): Gain Armor, Magic Resistance, and Attack Speed for each nearby enemy champion.

augmentChanges.name: No Mana, No Problem
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): All mana from your items converts to Ability Power.

augmentChanges.name: Sound Barrier
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): Your shields grant Move Speed.

augmentChanges.name: Ultimate Recursion
augmentChanges.change: New (Silver): Gain 50 Ultimate Ability Haste.

augmentChanges.name: Arcane Axiom
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Takedowns refund part of your Ultimate cooldown.

augmentChanges.name: Armored Impact
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): After using an ability, your next Attack deals bonus damage based on your Armor.

augmentChanges.name: BEES!!!
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Abilities occasionally throw an exploding beehive that damages, slows, and applies On-Hit effects.

augmentChanges.name: Brass Blast
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Gain a Summoner Spell that charges a horn blast to knock back and damage enemies.

augmentChanges.name: CRIMSON COBALT
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): One ability marks enemy champions. Consuming the mark deals extra damage and reduces that ability's cooldown.

augmentChanges.name: Double Time
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Damaging enemy champions with two different abilities in quick succession grants permanent Mana and extra damage.

augmentChanges.name: Enchanting Butterflies
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Healing and shielding allies summons butterflies that fly at damaged enemies once you have enough.

augmentChanges.name: Get Jinxed
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Gain a Summoner Spell that lets you ride a rocket into enemies.

augmentChanges.name: Heavy Is The Crown
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Gain AD, AP, and Attack Speed but lose Move Speed. Takedowns strengthen this effect, and dying weakens it.

augmentChanges.name: Jeweled Bracelet
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Your Ultimate can now critically strike.

augmentChanges.name: Recoil
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): One ability launches you backward when cast.

augmentChanges.name: Salvation
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Falling to low Health pushes enemies back and heals allies.

augmentChanges.name: Sap Magic
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Every 10 seconds, your next Attack deals extra damage and heals you.

augmentChanges.name: Still Here
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Gain AD, AP, and Lifesteal based on how low your Health is.

augmentChanges.name: Take'em Down Down Down
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): Damage an enemy champion five times with Attacks and abilities to gain healing and extra damage.

augmentChanges.name: The Boom and the Bass
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): After casting an ability, your next attack deals bonus damage and grants a burst of Move Speed.

augmentChanges.name: Tickle Monster
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): All AD from your items converts to Attack Speed.

augmentChanges.name: Upgrade Stormsurge
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): When Stormsurge applies Squall, it detonates in an area for extra damage and marks enemies with a secondary Squall.

augmentChanges.name: Weapon of Destiny
augmentChanges.change: New (Gold): The first Legendary item you buy gains stronger stats with each takedown.

augmentChanges.name: Big Shot
augmentChanges.change: New (Prismatic): A large portion of your Attack Speed converts to Critical Strike Damage.

augmentChanges.name: Bouncing Bees
augmentChanges.change: New (Prismatic): After using an ability, your next Attack bounces to nearby enemies, prioritizing champions. A quest adds bounces and AD for bouncing to champions.

augmentChanges.name: Group Hug
augmentChanges.change: New (Prismatic): An ability that heals or shields also heals or shields nearby allies.

augmentChanges.name: Mosh Monster
augmentChanges.change: New (Prismatic): Ultimate grants Bonus Health and creates a zone that slows enemy champions. Takedowns increase both the Health and zone size.

augmentChanges.name: Third Times the Harm
augmentChanges.change: New (Prismatic): Attacking an enemy champion three times deals a burst of damage and grants a burst of Attack Speed.

augmentChanges.name: Totentanz
augmentChanges.change: New (Prismatic): Gain a Summoner Spell that grants 5 seconds of immortality. Without a takedown in that window, you are dragged to the underworld.
